---
title: "Week 2: Historical Policy Echoes: How the Past Becomes the Present"
---

## Theme

The 1930s Home Owners\' Loan Corporation did not just deny mortgages ---
it engineered the geography of life expectancy. This week we trace the
legal history of state-sponsored residential segregation and its direct,
measurable effects on contemporary health outcomes. We introduce the
Opportunity Atlas, begin working with HOLC shapefiles and spatial joins,
and introduce HMDA mortgage data as a tool for documenting present-day
lending discrimination. This week\'s lab is the technical foundation for
Assignment 1, due next Friday.

## Classroom Lab Demonstration

**Legal Focus:** Fair Housing Act of 1968; HOLC (Home Owners\' Loan
Corporation) as state-sponsored residential segregation; Home Mortgage
Disclosure Act (HMDA, 1975) as a legal transparency and accountability
tool requiring lenders to report application outcomes by race.

**Health Focus:** How 1930s government lending grades produced
neighborhood-level health disparities in life expectancy, preterm birth,
cardiovascular disease, and firearm injury that persist today.

**Data:** University of Richmond Mapping Inequality HOLC shapefiles
(dsl.richmond.edu/panorama/redlining); Opportunity Atlas tract-level
outcome data (opportunityinsights.org/data); ACS life expectancy
estimates via tidycensus; HMDA Ohio mortgage application data (Consumer
Financial Protection Bureau, ffiec.cfpb.gov/hmda).

**R Code:** sf::st_read() for shapefiles; tidycensus::get_acs() for ACS
data; sf::st_join() for spatial joins by GEOID; ggplot2 choropleth maps
with geom_sf() and scale_fill_viridis_c(); dplyr summarise() to compute
group means by HOLC grade.

- Load University of Richmond HOLC shapefiles for Columbus using
  sf::st_read()

- Load ACS life expectancy data at census tract level via
  tidycensus::get_acs()

- Perform spatial join: match HOLC grade polygons to modern census
  tracts by GEOID using sf::st_join()

- Calculate mean life expectancy per HOLC grade; produce a bar chart and
  choropleth map in ggplot2

- Preview Opportunity Atlas data: load CSV, filter to Ohio (state FIPS =
  39), explore variables kfr_black_female_p25, kfr_white_female_p25 ---
  full analysis due as Assignment 1 next Friday

- Load Ohio HMDA data subset from Carmen; compute loan denial rates by
  applicant race; map at census tract level; overlay with HOLC
  boundaries
